g.text: You write Documents. Their text is kept as passages, ready to search.
A Schema lists the fields a kind of document has. The LLM fills them in.
A Collection keeps one record per thing — one per supplier, across all its contracts.
Search finds the passages that answer a question.
Query filters and counts on fields and records, like a spreadsheet.
